title: Evidence pack for one flagged reconciliation reversal (map step 3)
description: The only output the model may return. Sent to the Messages API as output_config.format (json_schema) and checked again by validatePack in harness.mjs, which adds the contract rules a schema cannot express. There is deliberately no field for a decision: the analyst decides.

claims.description: One fact per claim, each with its source. The first claim is the code check.

text.description: One short sentence. Counts copied exactly from checks; no new figures; no RIDs.

confidence.description: No higher than checks.maxConfidence; not_applicable for not_enough_evidence and code_not_on_acceptable_list.

missingEvidence.description: What the analyst would need. Required when the reading is not_enough_evidence.

reviewerNote.description: At most three sentences for the analyst. Never recommends an outcome.
